name: audio_music_generate
description: AI music generation. Google Lyria or ElevenLabs. Pass `prompt`; `model` carries the per-model duration limits.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds. Required for ElevenLabs v1/v2. Effective for google-lyria-3-pro (30–180) and ElevenLabs v1/v2 (10–300). Ignored for fixed-duration models.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

instrumental.description: Omit vocals. Only applicable for ElevenLabs v1/v2.

model.description: Default: google-lyria. google-lyria/google-lyria-3 = fixed 30s. google-lyria-3-pro = 30–180s. ElevenLabs v1/v2 = 10–300s.

prompt.description: Music description. Min 10 chars, max 2000. Describe genre, mood, instruments, tempo.
